hero.title: Bitcoin Rebounds After Rough Week, But Traders Are Pricing In More Downside
hero.description: Bitcoin bounced after dipping to around $80,000. Traders are placing increasingly high odds BTC slips further before October is over.

latest.title: HSBC, Ant Digital test AI-agent payments using tokenized deposits
latest.description: The technical trial showed how AI agents could discover services and make micropayments using HSBC’s tokenized deposits, with real-time settlement and risk checks.

latest.title: Verizon stock heads for worst day since 2002 as SpaceX U.S. network plans whack telcos
latest.description: SpaceX announced the spectrum deal Thursday, as the company aims to push deeper into the telecom market through its Starlink service.

latest.title: Tesla drops 'Full Self-Driving' brand name in Europe after regulator pushback
latest.description: German regulators called Tesla's "Full Self-Driving" brand name "somewhat misleading."

latest.title: Hurricane Isaias disrupts U.S. oil production in Gulf of Mexico, threatens refineries
latest.description: The hurricane could tighten a fuel market that is already facing big disruptions from the wars in Eastern Europe and the Middle East.

latest.title: Ledger investigates fund losses linked to Southeast Asian reseller, warns users
latest.description: Hardware wallet maker Ledger probes losses tied to reseller CryptoBilis, as researchers separately estimate more than $72 million to $86 million in suspected crypto thefts.

latest.title: Cramer: Investors selling Apple on latest iPhone 18 report are 'stupid as plywood'
latest.description: Cramer says investors who don't own the stock should use Friday's weakness to build a position.

latest.title: Ethereum L2 Starknet Jumps 20% After Saying It Wants to Become an L1
latest.description: Starknet is "actively considering" becoming its own blockchain, a move it says would make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

latest.title: Blockchain.com pursues CFTC approval for prediction markets: CNBC
latest.description: The crypto company has reportedly applied for two licenses with the US commodities regulatory as the courts weigh prediction markets cases.

latest.title: Americans' debt problems are flashing a warning not seen since the Great Recession
latest.description: Researchers found that while wealth disparities narrowed somewhat, the ability to meet debt payments deteriorated significantly.

latest.title: Trump appoints committee to investigate statements by the Fed's Lisa Cook
latest.description: Trump tried to fire Cook, a nominee of former President Joe Biden, but the Supreme Court blocked his first attempt.

latest.title: DWF Labs Subsidiaries Sue BitGo for $141 Million Over Early Token Sales
latest.description: The DWF Labs-linked firms allege in London’s High Court that BitGo sold discounted Falcon Finance and ESPORTS tokens roughly two months before their lock-up expired, cratering the value of their remaining holdings.

latest.title: New York AG Secures Up to $35M and Industry Ban From Ex-Celsius CEO Alex Mashinsky
latest.description: Mashinsky owes New York $25 million if he fails to forfeit another $10 million, and $10 million more if he doesn't serve his full sentence.

latest.title: Crypto Biz: Wealthy investors are buying crypto, but their advisers aren’t sold
latest.description: Wealthy investors are embracing crypto faster than their advisers, while OKX attracts new funding and Strategy shifts more capital toward preferred stock buybacks.

latest.title: Ledger Probes Potential Theft of $87M in User Funds Tied to Crypto Wallet Reseller
latest.description: Ledger asked reseller CryptoBilis to pause sales and urged recent buyers not to set up their devices, as an onchain investigator tracked more than $86 million in suspected thefts.

latest.title: ICE won't pause enforcement in NY after Bronx shooting, DHS' Mullin says
latest.description: New York Gov. Kathy Hochul said she asked Homeland Security Secretary Mullin and President Donald Trump to immediately halt ICE operations in her state.

latest.title: Bitcoin consolidates near $82.5K as crypto weathers Ledger theft reports
latest.description: Bitcoin and crypto markets eyed a recovery from Thursday’s drop despite concerns of another hardware wallet exploit.

latest.title: Wall Street is pitching data centers as a major real estate bet. The risks are piling up
latest.description: Wall Street firms are bringing AI data center investments to public markets as political, liquidity and project risks grow.

latest.title: ChatGPT for Teens is not necessarily 'safer than the previous version,' Common Sense Media finds
latest.description: Common Sense Media released its report about ChatGPT for Teens' new features, concluding the tool does not meet the safety standards OpenAI set.

latest.title: Delta Air Lines cuts 2026 forecast on fuel surge, but CEO says demand is still strong
latest.description: Delta Air Lines reported third-quarter earnings and missed Wall Street estimates for the first time in two years.
